source_read: Waterfields' own Shopify shop, www.waterfields-bakers.co.uk: the product feed products.json?limit=250 (50 products, sha256 7ebcbb6c792ca8eb6a4befe0abc226855a78fbe3b17d83b2b58a122b2d3cce44 on 2026-10-12) for the extraction, and each of the 22 product pages that print a nutrition table (https://www.waterfields-bakers.co.uk/products/<handle>) for the second read; the three collection feeds (bread, savouries, cream-cakes) for the shop's own grouping. robots.txt of the host allows /products/, /collections/ and /pages/ (disallows only cart, checkout, account, admin, filter and /cdn/wpm/*.js paths). The site banner says '36 shops across the North West'. No date or version is printed on the tables.
not_verifiable: allergens: the chain's allergen page embeds 12 published Google Sheets whose product names don't match several published products exactly (Eclair, Vanilla, Steak Pie, Medium Pork Pie, Spicy Vegetable Pastie, Small Crown Cob, GI Bread) and whose Cream Cakes sheet uses a '*' mark its key doesn't define, so the chain is link-only; item weights (never printed)
notes: Extraction (tools/uk_extract/waterfields.py) splits the feed's description HTML into table cells and reads the 13 labelled rows '<per item> / <per 100 g>'. Second read, by a different method and path: each product's own HTML page was fetched (22 pages, one a second) and its schema.org JSON-LD Product 'description' (plain text, not the feed's HTML) searched with one regular expression per label ('Energy (kcal): a / b' and so on); all 164 published per-item figures of the 15 published products (kcal, kJ, fat, saturates, mono- and polyunsaturates, carbohydrate, sugars, fibre, protein, salt) are identical, and the 6 held products with two columns print the same contradictory figures on their pages (the White Baguette's single column is why it is held). Held back as their own tables contradict themselves (holdback.csv names the figures): Lancashire Pastie and Potato and Meat Pie (kJ about 7.6-8.2 x kcal, in both columns), Pastie Large (word-for-word the Potato and Meat Pie table), Small White Tin Loaf (1,680 kcal per item = 8 x its per-100 g kcal, while kJ and every macro are 4 x), Large White Tin Loaf (sodium 10.4 g against salt 4.16 g), White Baguette (one unlabelled column), and, beyond the six found on 2026-10-11, Sausage Roll (1,111 kJ against 289 kcal, 8% apart, outside the audit's 7% line, and its per-item column repeats the per-100 g column). Medium Pork Pie: its polyunsaturates print '0.5728 / 032' (the two columns disagree), so that one optional figure is left blank and the rest published. Sodium (printed in grams beside salt) and starch are not published. Vegetarian tags only where the description says 'This product is suitable for vegetarians.' (Spicy Vegetable Pastie, Cheese & Onion Pastie); pork/beef tags from the descriptions' own words.
